D/ HADRIANVS AVGUSTVS PP ; R/ COS III

An incomplete silver denarius of the Roman period from the reign of Hadrian (AD117-138). RIC II 345, mint of Rome AD134-8. Obverse description:Bearded and laureate bust right. Obverse inscription:HADRIANVS AVGUSTVS PP. Reverse description:Victory seated left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription:COS III . The coin is in a good condition with minimal wear on both faces,it has either been clipped or stuck off centre with excess metal being from 5 to 7 o'clock. There is a small nick in the metal at twelve o'clock. Thickness: 2.07 mm. Weight: 2.7 g. Diameter: 19.23 mm
